Description
The MINI® Fuse is the standard for vehicle circuit protection. Its
miniature design meets the need for more circuits to be protected
while utilizing less space, and its ability to cope with high
temperatures in adverse environments makes the MINI® Fuse of
recommended choice for protection.

           200                         0.15 s / 5 s
           350                      0.080 s / 0.500 s
           600                      0.030 s / 0.100 s
